platformRules: State the chosen language, runtime, dependency versions, storage and deployment environment only when supplied or explicitly proposed for review; distinguish assumptions from confirmed facts.
Map approved process steps and owners to modules, input/output contracts and data ownership without changing process lineage or approval gates.

For workflow, agent and hybrid profiles, identify deterministic steps versus model-driven decisions, bounded execution and the owner of each consequential action. Do not introduce agents when the selected profile is workflow.
Document authentication, tenant isolation, input validation, server-only secrets and least-privilege access. Model output and generated code never grant authority.
Specify unit, integration, negative-authorization and failure-recovery tests, redacted telemetry and operational ownership; unexecuted tests are a plan, not passing evidence.

Provide dependency/license review, deployment assumptions and application rollback preserving business history. Return a reviewable build brief, not executed source, infrastructure changes or an automatic deployment.
